title: Advancing Zero-Shot Digital Human Quality Assessment through Text-Prompted Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-dataset generalization by comparing the performance of supervised quality assessment models across different databases (SJTU-H3D and DHHQA) to measure performance degradation caused by overfitting to limited training data.

Quantitatively characterizing the geometry (using standard deviation of dihedral angles) and color complexity (using standard deviation of LAB color channels) of reference 3D models to ensure high diversity and minimize source model selection bias.
